purpose: Structural and provenance validation contract for the prospective EXP-024 controlled dataset. This is not the formal dataset.

source_family_id.description: Unique source-family identifier. Must be invariant within a source family and must not cross partitions or conditions.

condition_id.description: Must match an ID in condition_panel_spec.json.

base_content_identity.description: Deterministic content identity hash or stable canonical ID for the underlying semantic content.

transformation_rule_id.description: Must match the condition transformation rule ID.

text.description: The actual model-input text for the record role.

independence_group.description: Optional grouping used to audit paraphrase/lineage independence.

provenance.description: Creation/review provenance object. Must include creator_task, reviewer_task, created_at_utc, frozen_sha256 when frozen.

family_uniqueness.rule: Each source_family_id must appear in exactly one condition*partition cell.

class_balance.rule: Within each condition*partition cell, every semantic class must have the exact allocated family count.

condition_balance.rule: Each condition must contain all four semantic classes and all three partitions.

partition_balance.rule: Across the dataset, each condition must contain exactly 22 families per semantic class across partitions: 6 FIT + 8 DIAGNOSTIC + 8 EVAL.

record_role_balance.rule: Each source family must contain exactly one reference_form record and exactly one condition_realization record.

no_outcome_fields.rule: The dataset must not contain future scientific outcome fields such as hidden_state, prediction, balanced_accuracy, S_diag, G_eval, or calibration result.

provenance_required.rule: Every record must include creation provenance and review provenance; frozen dataset must include a dataset-level SHA-256.

text_nonempty.rule: Every text field must be nonempty and must not equal the text of another unrelated family unless independently justified.

condition_id_known.rule: Every condition_id must exist in condition_panel_spec.json.

transformation_rule_id_known.rule: Every transformation_rule_id must match the condition_id transformation rule.

requirements: Does not change across record roles
Encodes condition and partition for mechanical leakage checks
Does not rely on filename conventions alone

review_status_contract.PASS: Condition construct and record pass all prospective semantic and leakage checks.
review_status_contract.MODERATE_NONBLOCKING_LIMITATION: Nonfatal limitation is recorded and must remain visible.
review_status_contract.BLOCKING_CONSTRUCT_DEFECT: Record or condition must be corrected or replaced before freeze.

freeze_requirements: All condition review statuses must be PASS or MODERATE_NONBLOCKING_LIMITATION
No cross-partition or forbidden cross-condition family overlap
Dataset SHA-256 must be computed and recorded
Preregistration must be frozen with matching dataset SHA-256
